r-m2-002.q: What is the fundamental distinction between Regression and Classification problems?

wrong: It can automatically learn complex nonlinear features like a deep neural network

wrong: Because KNN requires all input variables to follow a standard normal distribution with mean=0 and std=1

wrong: They are the outliers farthest from the data cloud that the algorithm must remove
